proof_scope: classifier maps known pipeline signals to canonical codes, mints deterministic codes for ambiguous signals, and refuses cross-layer false matches; run via the real skill entrypoint and test runner, including pi research gate retry command mismatch. Includes Tau create-svg artifact-origin and handler-substitution failure codes.

claims.proves: triage-error classify maps 'zip contains N; maximum is M' -> webgpt_attachment_bundle_rejected and '/v4/v1/chat/completions' -> scillm_api_base_double_version_segment, mints a stable *_unclassified_* code for novel signals, and does not false-match a surf signal asked as scillm
claims.does_not_prove: repo-wide adoption by all skills (incremental rollout), or live ticket/agentic-eval/debugger composition

capability_claims.description: Maps any layer's raw signal to one unambiguous code (or a deterministic minted code).

cases.name: classifier-canonical-and-ambiguous-and-no-cross-layer
command: cd .. && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/tmp/triage-eval-venv uv run --with pytest --project . python -m pytest -q tests/ && ./run.sh classify --text "zip contains 9 files; maximum is 5" --layer surf && ./run.sh classify --text '{"failure_code":"handler_execution_failed","evidence":{"response_chars":0,"submit_meta_status":200}}' --layer ask && ./run.sh classify --text '{"checks":{"linkedin_top_applicant_status_accounted":false,"linkedin_premium_status_accounted":false},"source_accounting":{"linkedin_top_applicant":{"status":"FAILED"},"linkedin_premium":{"status":"FAILED"}},"preflight":{"expected_revision":"abc123"}}' --layer monitor-opportunities && ./run.sh classify --text '{"schema":"pi_research_gate.retry_misuse.v1","failure_code":"pi_research_gate_retry_command_mismatch","observed":"agent ran paraphrased memory query instead of the exact next_command"}' --layer pi

cases.name: create-svg-launch-receipt-active-code-beats-embedded-catalog
create-svg-browser-submit-failure-triages-to-recovery-packet
command: ../run.sh classify --text '{"failure_code":"browser_submit_not_accepted","failure":"Kimi prompt composer did not receive inserted text after 4 attempt(s)"}' --layer create-svg | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);assert d['code']=='create_svg_browser_submit_not_accepted' and d['ambiguous'] is False and 'browser-recovery-packet.json' in d['next_command'];print('CREATE_SVG_BROWSER_SUBMIT_TRIAGE_OK')"

cases.name: tau-create-svg-origin-gate-codes-classify-stably
command: for code in tau_dag_requested_handler_substituted create_svg_required_payload_missing create_svg_candidate_receipt_invalid create_svg_artifact_origin_invalid; do ../run.sh classify --text '{"failure_code":"'"$code"'"}' --layer tau.project_dag | EXPECTED_CODE=$code python3 -c 'import json,os,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);expected=os.environ["EXPECTED_CODE"];assert d["code"]==expected and d["ambiguous"] is False and d["recoverable"] is True;print(expected+"_OK")' || exit 1; done
